Questions

Frequently asked questions

What design services does Design360n offer?

Logo design, brand identity design, social media design, YouTube thumbnail design, motion graphics, packaging design, poster and banner design, and T-shirt and hoodie design.

Where is Design360n based?

Design360n is based in Narsingdi, Dhaka, Bangladesh, and works with clients in Bangladesh and worldwide.

How do I order a design?

Fill in the contact form on this page or message me on WhatsApp at +880 1799-137986. Tell me what you need, and I reply personally.

Do you work with clients outside Bangladesh?

Yes. I work with clients in Bangladesh and worldwide, including the USA and UK.

What will I receive when the design is done?

You receive the finished design files, ready to use for print or social media, in the formats your work needs.
